title: Cheapest-Viable Model Routing & Token-Return Optimization
hypothesis: Explicitly proposing and constraining tasks to their cheapest viable model tier (e.g. Gemini 3.8 Flash @ 0.1x, Claude Haiku 5.5 @ 0.2x, Codex Luna @ 1.0x) in mission manifests will reduce overall token/credit expenditure by at least 60% across autonomous research tasks without reducing task pass rate by more than 5 percentage points.
falsification_criteria: Autonomous dispatch fails to achieve >= 60% token savings compared to frontier-default dispatch, or task success rate degrades by > 5 percentage points on benchmark evaluations.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Only escalate to astra/opus if verification test fails > 2 times
